human_rationale: Three variants, three different decisions. layout_a: +2.4% significant (p=0.008), guardrails intact — ship. layout_b: -1.6% with ctr -5.6% past the -3% guardrail — do not ship. layout_c: +0.8% not significant (p=0.29) with only 6 of 21 days accumulated — nothing is wrong with it, the term is short: continue measuring. A single verdict on the experiment is wrong whatever it says.
